title: Edge Computing Topology Rules
description: Architectural rules for the Edge Computing topology.

rules.title: Mandatory Synchronization Strategy
rules.description: An Edge Computing satellite MUST provide edge-computing.config.json and declare syncStrategy (offline-first, eventual, or real-time-fallback).

rules.title: Conflict Resolution Strategy
rules.description: edge-computing.config.json MUST declare conflictResolution (last-write-wins, merge, or manual).
